description: In the Musée de l'Hydraviation at Biscarrosse. An original float from Henri Fabre's 1910 Canard is displayed at the back of the workshop; the float is the original component, not a complete aircraft.
In the Musée de l'Hydraviation at Biscarrosse. Full-scale reproduction in the exhibition hall.
In the Musée de l'Hydraviation at Biscarrosse. Italian Schneider Trophy racing seaplane, hung from the ceiling; the left wing is slightly longer than the right.

In the Musée de l'Hydraviation at Biscarrosse. A substantial original wing section with the internal crawlway used by flight mechanics, plus a faithfully reconstructed cabin fitted out with original windows, seats and fittings. Not a complete airframe.

In the Musée de l'Hydraviation at Biscarrosse. Full-size Albatross displayed in the outdoor area. Serial not published; the museum also shows a scale model of the type acquired in 2018, which is not this airframe.
